title.description: Human-readable title (file name, page heading, repo display name).

source.description: Origin kind — git | upload | url. Wire key.

sourceRef.description: Origin pointer — git URL+ref, uploaded blob id, or fetched URL.

mimeType.description: Detected MIME type of the original bytes (text/markdown, text/plain, …).

text.description: Raw text the worker chunks + embeds.

description:
One ingest call — the body of `POST /api/v1/knowledge/ingest`.
string KnowledgeIngestRequest.Source is a wire key (`git` | `upload` |
`url`); the text is the raw bytes the worker chunks and
embeds. The request is project-scoped (projectId) or global
(projectId omitted).
